Services

What I make.

01

Short-form editing

Fast, clear edits for Reels and Shorts, paced around a strong opening.

  • Instagram Reels & YouTube Shorts
  • Vertical promotional videos
  • Captions and subtitles
  • Hook-focused pacing
  • Sound design and music sync
  • Clean transitions
02

Long-form YouTube

Edits that keep the story clear from start to finish.

  • Talking-head videos
  • Educational and commentary
  • Documentary-style storytelling
  • B-roll integration
  • Audio cleanup where possible
  • Color correction and pacing
03

Thumbnail design

Custom concepts tailored to your niche and your video.

  • Clear visual hierarchy
  • Strong composition
  • Readable typography
  • Image treatment and color grading
04
In development

Motion & effects

I’m currently developing my skills in Adobe After Effects and Premiere Pro. Work here is practice, not client delivery.

  • Typography animation
  • Transitions
  • Visual-effects exercises

About sunXvids

sunXvids is the independent video-editing division of sunXauto, run by Sathvik. It focuses on short-form edits, long-form YouTube editing and thumbnail design, while growing into motion graphics and visual effects. Clear communication and reliable delivery come first.

Work with me

Got raw clips? Got a reference reel?

Send me your raw footage and I’ll edit it. Or share a reference reel and I’ll recreate that style with your content. Pricing is fair and flexible: message me for a quote.

Get a quote

Instagram can’t prefill messages, so tapping the Instagram card copies “Hey! Will you make me an edit?” for you to paste in the chat.
